name: whatsapp-service
description: Internal messaging microservice (Phase 6 wires OpenWA). White-labeled behind ChannelProvider.
//optionalDependencies: The default image builds mock-capable (fast, no Chromium). For a live WhatsApp session, install @open-wa/wa-automate (pulls Puppeteer/Chromium) — e.g. `npm install @open-wa/wa-automate` — and rebuild without WHATSAPP_MOCK. The service dynamic-imports it and falls back to mock if absent.
